decisions.reason: Superyacht crew recruitment uses the firm's existing crewing network and seafarer pool, so it costs little to run and adds steady revenue.
The Smart Academy is growing its partner network quickly and supports the firm's training and crewing strategy, so keeping it is clearly worthwhile.
FuelEU Maritime monitoring is a regulatory requirement for clients' vessels, which makes it an essential, recurring service that is close to the core business.
The FuelEU Dashboard is built into the PAL software and supports the compliance service, so it costs little to maintain and supports the firm's digitalisation strategy.
The FuelEU Simulator helps clients plan their compliance costs and is integrated into PAL, which strengthens the firm's integrated emissions offering.
